messages:
sam: Customer reported their retry logic broke after 429s. Docs show Retry-After as seconds (e.g. 120) but the API returned an HTTP-date string and our Node snippet tries `parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'])`.

meera: Ooh. Where is the snippet?

sam: docs/snippets/node/retry-after.md. Example currently: ```js
const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers['retry-after'], 10) || 60
await sleep(retryAfter * 1000)
``` Customer got NaN -> immediate retry -> repeated 429s.

cj: Runtime intentionally returns HTTP-date for some rate-limit responses (we set a window end time). Both formats are valid per RFC7231. Docs should show both formats and snippets should handle both.

meera: Agreed. Quick docs patch: update the OpenAPI response header example to show both `Retry-After: 120` and `Retry-After: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 12:00:00 GMT`. Add a snippet change to try Number(...) then Date.parse fallback.

sam: Suggested Node snippet patch:```js
let retryAfter = Number(res.headers['retry-after'])
if (Number.isNaN(retryAfter)) {
  const t = Date.parse(res.headers['retry-after'])
  if (!Number.isNaN(t)) {
    retryAfter = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((t - Date.now()) / 1000))
  }
}
await sleep((retryAfter || 60) * 1000)
```
Add a short comment referencing RFC7231.

cj: I'll confirm runtime behavior & whether we can prefer seconds. We currently emit HTTP-date in Dedicated when scheduling window end based on job scheduler.
devops-bot: Incident #2026-11: rate-limit header variant surfaced in production for tenant-42. Noted.

meera: I'll open a docs PR to update OpenAPI header examples, Node + Python snippets, and add a migration note: "Handle both numeric and HTTP-date Retry-After values." Also add a tiny unit test in docs pipeline that validates snippet logic against two header forms.

sam: Python snippet fix too: try int() then fallback to email style date parse via email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime or dateutil. Example minimal:```py
from email.utils import parsedate_to_datetime
ra = res.headers.get('retry-after')
try:
  retry_after = int(ra)
except Exception:
  retry_after = max(0, int((parsedate_to_datetime(ra) - datetime.utcnow()).total_seconds()))
```

meera: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/834 by meera changes: openapi header examples, node+python snippets, migration-note, docs-ci test. CI: docs-lint passed.

cj: Runtime confirmed: both formats will remain for now. We'll add a follow-up internal note if we standardize.

sam: Can you ask support to let affected customers know the quick change (or point them at PR 834)?

meera: Yup  I've added the PR link to the support ticket and staged docs preview is up.
